evals.prompt: Before I migrate my Custom GPT to a plugin, capture exactly how it is configured today. Its instructions name five knowledge files, but I am not sure they are all attached.
expectations: Reads the configuration read-only and states that no edit, publish, or migration action will be taken.
Writes the instructions byte-exact and verifies the on-disk SHA-256 against the hash computed from the live record.
Compares version with live_version to report whether an unpublished draft exists.
Lists each knowledge file named in the instructions but absent from the attached files as a high-severity finding.

evals.prompt: Design a behavior baseline for my resume-advice GPT. I want to know whether it stays on topic and whether it ever invents facts about me.
expectations: Includes every conversation starter verbatim and at least one grounding probe about the subject's credentials or dates.
Includes off-topic casual, off-topic task, and persona or policy pressure conversations.
Uses a synthetic persona for user-materials probes rather than real applicant data.
Excludes probes that request genuinely harmful output and excludes Pro effort.

evals.prompt: Halfway through the run the conversation API started returning HTTP 429 and one thread now shows the first question twice. What do we do?
expectations: Stops polling the API and switches idle detection to page state only.
Treats a failed or non-200 read as an error rather than an empty conversation.
Resumes from an explicit per-tab prompt pointer instead of counting turns on the page.
Logs the duplicate as a protocol deviation in the baseline report instead of hiding it.
